sql.up: LOCK TABLE public.users, public.workflows, public.apps, public.app_versions, public.credential IN SHARE ROW EXCLUSIVE MODE; DO $$ BEGIN IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.users WHERE id = '') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.workflows WHERE submitted_by = '') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.apps WHERE owner = '') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.app_versions WHERE created_by = '') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'empty persistent user identity'; END IF; INSERT INTO public.user_identities (id) SELECT id FROM public.users WHERE id IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT submitted_by FROM public.workflows WHERE submitted_by IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT owner FROM public.apps WHERE owner IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT created_by FROM public.app_versions WHERE created_by IS NOT NULL ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING; DELETE FROM public.credential AS credential WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.users WHERE users.id = credential.user_name); IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid = 'public.users'::regclass AND conname = 'users_identity_fkey') THEN ALTER TABLE public.users ADD CONSTRAINT users_identity_fkey FOREIGN KEY (id) REFERENCES public.user_identities(id) NOT VALID; END IF; IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid = 'public.workflows'::regclass AND conname = 'workflows_submitted_by_identity_fkey') THEN ALTER TABLE public.workflows ADD CONSTRAINT workflows_submitted_by_identity_fkey FOREIGN KEY (submitted_by) REFERENCES public.user_identities(id) NOT VALID; END IF; IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid = 'public.apps'::regclass AND conname = 'apps_owner_identity_fkey') THEN ALTER TABLE public.apps ADD CONSTRAINT apps_owner_identity_fkey FOREIGN KEY (owner) REFERENCES public.user_identities(id) NOT VALID; END IF; IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid = 'public.app_versions'::regclass AND conname = 'app_versions_created_by_identity_fkey') THEN ALTER TABLE public.app_versions ADD CONSTRAINT app_versions_created_by_identity_fkey FOREIGN KEY (created_by) REFERENCES public.user_identities(id) NOT VALID; END IF; IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid = 'public.credential'::regclass AND conname = 'credential_user_name_fkey') THEN ALTER TABLE public.credential ADD CONSTRAINT credential_user_name_fkey FOREIGN KEY (user_name) REFERENCES public.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE NOT VALID; END IF; ALTER TABLE public.users VALIDATE CONSTRAINT users_identity_fkey; ALTER TABLE public.workflows VALIDATE CONSTRAINT workflows_submitted_by_identity_fkey; ALTER TABLE public.apps VALIDATE CONSTRAINT apps_owner_identity_fkey; ALTER TABLE public.app_versions VALIDATE CONSTRAINT app_versions_created_by_identity_fkey; ALTER TABLE public.credential VALIDATE CONSTRAINT credential_user_name_fkey; END $$; CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS users_base_username_id_idx ON public.users ((split_part(id, '@', 1)), id)
